name: Nicolette Boele I move amendments (1) to (7) as circulated in my name: (1) Schedule 1, item 18, page 12 (line 17), omit "and to allow users to opt out of receiving such content", substitute ", and to ensure that users who have opted in to receiving such content can withdraw that opt-in at any time. (2) Schedule 1, item 18, page 22 (lines 4 to 7), omit paragraph 62H(d), substitute: (d) has not opted in to accessing or receiving wagering advertising content provided on the online content service in accordance with section 62S. (3) Schedule 1, item 18, page 22 (after line 7), at the end of section 62H, add: Note: An online content service provider must not provide incentives for an individual in Australia to opt in (see section 62SA).
